t: 梵蒂冈召开一个议会,查理曼将在会议上对教皇利奥三世的指控进行评判.
te: A council is convened in the Vatican, at which Charlemagne is to judge the accusations against Pope Leo III.

t: 查理曼大帝在罗马加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
te: The coronation of Charlemagne as Holy Roman Emperor, in Rome.
